info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database person API
A list of people with first or last name partly matching a given string

params.name: view
params.description: Global parameter - Customise the view to be more concise and/or aggregate relationships

params.name: includeRef
params.description: Global parameter - If true, replace element ref to dbId by standard JSOG object {@ref}

items.docs: Retrieves a list of people in Reactome with either their first or last name partly matching the given string.
